picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's leadership on 13 projects (plus 30+ partnerships) makes it the single largest node in DOE's new Genesis Mission, the flagship national AI-for-science initiative uniting national labs, universities, and industry.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: Oak Ridge's role leading nine Genesis Mission projects and contributing to 32 more cements its position as a computing anchor for the initiative, leveraging its supercomputing infrastructure at national scale.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: NASA's entry into the Genesis Mission, alongside 15+ federal agencies under a presidential executive order, signals a genuine whole-of-government commitment to AI-accelerated science rather than a single-agency program.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $83M investment in AI-ready data infrastructure addresses a foundational bottleneck for AI-driven research across disciplines, complementing the compute-focused Genesis Mission awards with critical data-layer funding.
picks.title: NSF announces $83M investment in integrated data systems and services to advance AI-driven science and strengthen U.S. research infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: Penn State's $20M award to lead a national 'programmable cloud laboratory' node represents a distinct and substantial NSF investment in autonomous, AI-run experimentation infrastructure.
picks.title: Penn State awarded $20M to lead an NSF ‘programmable cloud laboratory’ | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: CuspAI's £330M raise at a £2 billion valuation, with an Imperial College scientist as Chief Scientific Officer, shows deep-tech AI-for-materials startups attracting major private capital at a scale rivaling public funding programs.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: The expanded TUM-MIT partnership, with reciprocal researcher exchanges funded by the Bavarian government, exemplifies deepening transatlantic academic collaboration in AI and robotics.
picks.title: TUM and MIT are expanding their strategic partnership in the fields of AI and robotics. The Bavarian Ministry of Science is providing 1.6 million.

picks.editorial_note: A new deep learning model revealing how 3D genome architecture differs in Alzheimer's patients is a concrete scientific finding with direct implications for understanding neurodegenerative disease.
picks.title: AI, Single-Cell Technology Reveal How 3D Genome Differs in People With Alzheimer's Disease

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's SAGA tool, developed with YouTube and Google DeepMind, doesn't just detect AI-generated fake video but identifies its source model, a meaningful advance for combating disinformation at real-world scale.
picks.title: New tool identifies the sources of fake videos

picks.editorial_note: RIKEN's AGIS program to build generative AI foundation models and scientific AI agents marks Japan's major entry into the global race for AI-for-science infrastructure.
picks.title: TRIP Headquarters Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program (AGIS)
